degradation_contract.scope: Reuse original V3 case IDs, seeds, realized disturbances, source masks and registered half-open windows only in their original measurement/provider layer.
degradation_contract.fault_time_semantics: Frozen one-second signed angular disturbance cells carried to 5 Hz; no new independent 5 Hz draws. Existing non-heading fault bytes retained.
degradation_contract.D61_D62: Validity/status outages in frozen GNSS/RD/HV provider roles; not RAWX phase slips or receiver raw-message erasure.
degradation_contract.D40: Baseline quality metadata has no active scalar measurement path.
degradation_contract.D41: Inherited scalar angular perturbation; not a new raw carrier or full 3D fault experiment.
degradation_contract.raw_fault_comparison_rule: A later raw phase/slip/missing-message test may use these raw records/windows but must register a new physical observation fault contract and new comparison identity; old V3 degraded scores cannot be relabeled as that baseline.

reuse_without_solver: Frozen V3 registered configurations and providers after identity checks
Saved original V3 metrics, error series, output receipts and failure records
Original full sequence windows, initialization, evaluation time base and physical-point contract
new_method_required: Execute only the newly registered method on each full V3 sequence window, with explicit new-source/configuration identity.
Seal outputs before the unchanged offline reference evaluator and v3 physical-point transform.
Report no-output, cold-start and unavailable-carrier portions; no cropping to successful carrier epochs.
not_equivalent: Current BY2 100–340 s carrier development window is not the full 66–340 s V3 window.
Current research scalar/PVT/carrier controls and causal body-HV providers are not original V3 reproductions.
Original PVT/provider-layer degradation is not raw-carrier-layer degradation.
Sharing a frozen evaluator executable alone does not preserve its input physical-point/window/base-time contract.
